title: Race-pace tempo 2x20min, PM spin 45min
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 15m easy, 2x20min at 160-166bpm (4min jog), 10m easy. Cadence 170+. PM spin 45min at 134-147bpm, cadence 90+.
GYM: none.
FUEL: 1 gel before rep 2 (race rehearsal).
GARMIN: run ~130, spin ~45.
STOP RULE: HR over 168 in rep 2 = hold pace, finish at 15min. Sleep under 6h = spin 30min.
WHY: 40min at race HR; spin +15min is the +10% add, zero impact.
